Ethan Morales: Quick pre-EBR check — can we get a 2-slide exec snapshot (health + asks) and a one-paragraph talking point? Ping owners.
Priya Shah: Sure — I uploaded a first draft to the QBR folder: https://drive/reports/qbr-1758. It’s rough, needs adoption metrics.
Liam Chen: Onboarding metrics updated in the sheet, FYI. Demo still flaky for long-chat state :grimacing: I’ll look into it.
Samira Patel: Heads up — AtlasPay usage dipped last 30d, showing renewal risk. Recommend a targeted enablement push before the EBR.
Danielle Ruiz: Agree with Samira. I’ll build a short adoption heatmap + top-3 blocker slide.
Ethan Morales: Can everyone confirm owners and ETA by EOD? Also need a concise exec paragraph (2-3 sentences) for the readout.
Liam Chen: @Ethan I’ve started a reproducible run. Quick note: the error appears when context > 8k tokens. Test command I’m using: `./run_demo.sh --profile long-context`.
qbr-bot: Reminder: EBR dry run scheduled today 15:00 PT — please be ready.
Priya Shah: I’ll consolidate the action items and run the dry run notes. @Danielle will you own the adoption slide?
Danielle Ruiz: Yes — taking ownership. Draft will be in the deck in ~45m: https://drive/reports/qbr-1758/adoption
Samira Patel: I’ll set up a short enablement touch with AtlasPay CSMs (30m) to surface blockers. Proposing Thu 10:00 PT — will confirm.
Ethan Morales: Action list for EOD (copying into thread):
```
1) Adoption slide — Danielle Ruiz (due 18:00 PT)
2) Demo stability triage — Liam Chen (PR/patch ETA 90m)
3) Exec talking points (2-3 sentences) — Priya Shah (due 17:00 PT)
4) Outreach + enablement event — Samira Patel (schedule by EOD)
5) Update risk register & summary slide — Ethan Morales (I’ll own consolidation)
```
Priya Shah: :thumbsup: I’ll update the deck and post final slides by 18:00 PT.
Liam Chen: Found reproducer, likely tokenization boundary mismatch causing state bleed. Building patch + rollback plan — PR expected in ~90 minutes.
Ethan Morales: Great. If anything blocks the dry run, tag #release-war-room and call out immediate customer impact. Also capture any direct customer quotes for the feedback slide.
qbr-bot: Dry run checklist: slides in drive, demo link, talk track. Mark ✅ when ready.
Priya Shah: :white_check_mark: Final deck uploaded, adoption slide + talking points included. Ready for dry run.
